notes: The bundle deliberately does NOT carry host runtime libraries, libvulkan.so.1 above all: the loader is the host's ICD loader and must match the host's driver. The consequence is that the bundle requires a host Vulkan driver, which the install guide must state. Whisper's shared objects now sit BESIDE the binary because CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN=ON yields RUNPATH $ORIGIN: with no ../lib component, so the old separate lib/ folder produced a binary that could not start; the patchelf dependency is gone as a result. The manifest records each path as it is at that path, so 13 unreproducible symlink byte-counts are gone; no integrity is lost because every link's target is also listed with its own hash. A one-line test-port change 7836 -> 7834 matches this card's dispatch and the 'never the live instance's 7717' invariant, but was not disclosed in the commit message.
